notes: Each entry is a TERM in the compositional grammar.
A rule compiles deterministically to AsmSource via rule-translator.ts (Phase 2).
Synonyms are aliases the RAG retrieval treats as the same term.

2026-06-14: exemplars repointed from the deleted dt_* parts to the live g_* migration (dt_*->g_*). expects_bake now reflects the EXEMPLAR part baked at its OWN meta.params defaults (was: translator output at vocab params). GAPS (frustum, mule_shoe) have no live g_* twin and are flagged stale:true; xover reuses dt_sub geometry. New terms spiral (g_spiral) + star (g_star) added.

0.5.0 (2026-06-15): SVTC completion batch — 36 graph-emitted r_revolve parts promoted as retrieval/exemplar anchors (kind:'asm', rule.kind:'graph_emitted', like spiral/star — NOT K.68 translator targets). Families: landing/seating nipples (BN/BX/BXN/AR/R), flow couplings + pup joints, sliding sleeve (SSD), TR-SCSSV safety valves (ball/flapper), bell guide, crossover, expansion/travel joints, tubing pup, gas-lift / side-pocket / gauge mandrels, reciprocating & shearable mule shoes, tubing hanger, and 12 production/sand-control packers. Existing 'mule_shoe' term repointed to the live g_mule_shoe (was stale).

shaft.definition: Cylindrical profile, half-section (r, len). The atomic primitive — every other rotational shape extends this.

tube.definition: Open tube — a smaller shaft subtracted from a larger shaft. Outer radius = od/2; inner radius = od/2 - wall.

expects_bake._note: g_tube @ defaults od=4.5, wall=0.5, length=3, segments=256.

collar_flat.definition: Flat-shouldered collar — locally-larger OD over a portion of length with SQUARE outer corners. A flange / shoulder / sleeve.

expects_bake._note: All three collar variants now share the single live exemplar g_collar (flat/tapered/rounded are no longer separate parts). Metrics: g_collar @ its meta.params defaults.

collar_tapered.definition: Tapered-shoulder collar — locally-larger OD over a portion of length with CHAMFERED (tapered) outer corners at both ends. The `taper` param controls chamfer depth.

expects_bake._note: All three collar variants now share the single live exemplar g_collar (flat/tapered/rounded are no longer separate parts). Metrics: g_collar @ its meta.params defaults.

collar_rounded.definition: Rounded-shoulder collar — locally-larger OD over a portion of length with FILLETED (rounded) outer corners at both ends. `fillet` controls the corner radius; `filletSteps` the smoothness.

expects_bake._note: All three collar variants now share the single live exemplar g_collar (flat/tapered/rounded are no longer separate parts). Metrics: g_collar @ its meta.params defaults.

pin.definition: Male tapered connection — shaft body + upset joint shoulder + tapered nose. Used as the male end of a tool joint.

thread_spec._note: Inline for v0.1. Will move to docs/parts/thread_specs.json when that KB exists. Translator reads `name` first, falls back to the raw fields below.
thread_spec.name: NC50

thdLen._note: Thread length. Joint upset (flat collar) length is then `jointLen - thdLen`.

rule._note: INLINE polygon (same coordinates dp_spec_pin computes). Encoded as preamble + polygon expressions so the ProfileFnEditor renders the half-section + lets the user dial individual vertices. Math extracted from dp_spec_pin's pen API: .mv(ri,0).line(pr,0).line(pr,z1).line(jr,z2).line(jr,z3).line(pinR0,z3).line(noseR,z4).line(ri,z4). The COLLAR (jr-radius section, z2..z3) length is `barrel = jointLen - thdLen` — both inputs. Default jointLen=6, thdLen=4 → barrel=2 inches of collar.
preamble: const upsetRun = Math.max(0.05, (jr - pr) / Math.tan(jointTaper * D2R));
const noseR = Math.max(ri + 0.05, pinR0 - thdLen * Math.tan(threadTaper * D2R));

box.definition: Female complement of pin — counterbored receptacle; the female end of a tool joint mating with a pin.

thread_spec._note: Metadata-only for v0.1 — geometry doesn't render threads yet (that needs r_threads overlay or similar, future work). Mates with pin of the same `name`.
thread_spec.name: NC50

rule._note: INLINE polygon — same coordinates dp_spec_box computes. Editor renders + lets the user dial each vertex. Math from dp_spec_box's pen API: .mv(mouthR,0).line(jr,0).line(jr,jointLen).line(pr,jointLen+upsetRun).line(pr,zPipe).line(ri,zPipe).line(ri,zSeat).line(floorR,zSeat).line(floorR,zFloor).
preamble: const upsetRun = Math.max(0.05, (jr - pr) / Math.tan(jointTaper * D2R));
const thdLen = Math.max(0.1, Math.min((mouthR - termR) / Math.tan(tt), jointLen - jtUpset - 0.1));

joint.definition: A box + tube body + pin stacked end-to-end via tail() datums. The unit drill-pipe joint.
joint.param_lifting_note: Box / Pin's deep params (pipeOD, jointOD, jtUpset, jointTaper, threadTaper, …) stay as STATIC defaults inside the rule — NOT lifted to joint.params. Joint exposes only {od, wall, body_len}. Deep-dial overrides go through editing the joint's rule, not through assembly-level params.

composition._note: Sequential end-to-end stack — handles tail() at runtime via manifold-helpers.stack().

cone.definition: Tapered cylindrical solid — radius r at base, narrowing to a point at top over length len. The basic tapered primitive.
cone._note: Params match the curated `cone` template's names (r, len) so the translator can scaffold without remapping. If we later want r_top/r_bot semantics (frustum-like), use the `frustum` term below or add a `template_param_map` to the rule.

frustum.definition: Barrel-shape via the curated `barrel` template — two end radii (rEnd) bulging or pinching to a mid radius (rMid).
frustum._note: Params match the curated `barrel` template's names (rEnd, rMid, len). Set rMid > rEnd → barrel bulge; rMid < rEnd → waisted hourglass.

expects_bake._note: stale — no live exemplar to bake.

frustum.stale_note: 2026-06-14: exemplar dt_frustum was deleted in the dt_*->g_* migration and has NO live g_* twin (no barrel/frustum part exists). Term retained for its rule/synonyms; exemplar is dead. USER DECISION: author a g_frustum (barrel) exemplar, or remap to the closest live part.

sub.definition: Short connection piece — box + pin with no body between. A 'crossover sub' but with the SAME thread spec on both ends. Used widely in BHA.
sub.param_lifting_note: Pin / Box deep params (pipeOD, jointOD, jtUpset, …) stay as static defaults inside the sub's rule. Sub exposes only {od, wall}.

composition._note: type:'stack' = sequential end-to-end mate via manifold-helpers.stack(). Each child's HEAD lands on the prior child's TAIL — handles the tail() math at runtime.

expects_bake._note: dt_sub survives the migration. Baked @ its defaults od=4.5, wall=0.5.

xover.definition: Crossover — different thread specs on each end (e.g. NC50 pin × NC46 box). Same composition as sub but with explicit thread metadata per end.

thread_spec._note: Different threads each end. Geometry currently same as sub — thread spec is metadata-only until r_threads overlay ships.

xover.exemplar_note: 2026-06-14: dt_xover was deleted; its geometry was identical to sub (per its own note — thread spec is metadata-only until r_threads ships). Repointed to the live dt_sub exemplar. USER DECISION: author a dedicated g_xover if/when per-end thread geometry renders.

stand.definition: N joints stacked end-to-end via tail() — typically 3 for a 'triple' stand.
stand.param_lifting_note: Same model as joint — pin/box/tube deep params stay static inside joint's rule. Stand exposes only {n, od, wall, body_len}.

mule_shoe.definition: Beveled-end pipe attached to the bottom of a drill or work string. Cut at a 45-degree angle on one side, it guides tubing into seal bores, washes out debris during fluid circulation, and directs the string safely past rock ledges during wellbore interventions. The open bore allows fluid circulation and tool passage. Also called a Wireline Entry Guide (WEG) when used as a centralising entry for intervention tools.
mule_shoe.exemplar_note: 2026-06-15: SVTC batch — exemplar repointed from the deleted dt_mule_shoe to the live g_mule_shoe (graph-emitted r_revolve). Rich K.69 boolean_modify rule retained as the descriptive rule; the live exemplar is the retrieval anchor.

spiral.definition: Helical ribbon swept around a central axis — a spiral / helical groove or flight. Radius grows from r0 by `growth` over `turns` revolutions; the band has rectangular cross-section `width` and overall axial `length`. Graph-emitted via r_weld_extrude (welded-mesh path).

rule._note: Geometry lives in the graph-emitted g_spiral part (meta.graph + r_weld_extrude). Not compilable by the K.68 rule-translator (no helix template) — like mule_shoe, this is a retrieval/exemplar anchor, not a translator target.

star.definition: Star / splined cross-section extruded straight down its axis — a prism whose section is `points` outer lobes (r_outer) alternating with inner valleys (r_inner). Models splined shafts, star points, and lobed keys. Graph-emitted via r_weld_extrude.

rule._note: Geometry lives in the graph-emitted g_star part (meta.graph + r_weld_extrude). Not compilable by the K.68 rule-translator — retrieval/exemplar anchor only.

nipple_bn.definition: Baker 'BN' bottom no-go landing nipple — heavy-wall tubing sub with a lock profile, honed seal bore, and a no-go restriction at the bottom so a wireline tool passes the profile and lands on the lower shoulder.

rule._note: Graph-emitted SVTC completion part (meta.graph + r_revolve). Retrieval/exemplar anchor only — NOT a K.68 rule-translator target, like spiral/star.

nipple_bx.definition: 'BX' selective landing nipple — X-profile lock recess plus seal bore with NO diameter restriction, so multiple same-bore nipples can be run in one string and addressed individually by the running tool.

rule._note: Graph-emitted SVTC completion part (meta.graph + r_revolve). Retrieval/exemplar anchor only — NOT a K.68 rule-translator target, like spiral/star.

nipple_bxn.definition: 'BXN' no-go landing nipple — the no-go counterpart of the BX selective profile (XN-style), adding a bottom diameter restriction so an oversized tool bottoms out and lands.

nipple_ar_no_go.definition: 'AR' no-go landing nipple — lock profile and seal bore with an inward no-go shoulder, giving a wireline mandrel a positive landing point that an oversized tool cannot pass.

rule._note: Graph-emitted SVTC completion part (meta.graph + r_revolve). Retrieval/exemplar anchor only — NOT a K.68 rule-translator target, like spiral/star.

nipple_r_landing.definition: Baker 'R' selective landing nipple — R-profile lock recess plus honed seal bore for locking and sealing wireline-run devices; the RN variant adds a bottom no-go restriction.

rule._note: Graph-emitted SVTC completion part (meta.graph + r_revolve). Retrieval/exemplar anchor only — NOT a K.68 rule-translator target, like spiral/star.

rule._note: Graph-emitted SVTC completion part (meta.graph + r_revolve). Retrieval/exemplar anchor only — NOT a K.68 rule-translator target, like spiral/star.

ssd_1.definition: Sliding side door / sliding sleeve (SSD) — a ported tubing sub whose inner sleeve shifts on wireline to open or close communication between the tubing bore and the annulus for circulation or selective production.
